chunks: So do not let those who do not believe in it and follow their vain desires, turn you away from it.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that can turn one away from divine guidance according to Surah Taa-Haa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the necessity of intellectual independence for the believer, warning that succumbing to *hawa* (capricious desire) leads to spiritual ruin, a concept deeply linked to the Imamate as the safeguard against such deviation. It serves as a practical guide for maintaining fidelity to divine truth amidst societal pressures, emphasizing that true guidance requires resisting the allure of worldly whims.
